summary: Core product fully green (1306 tests, typecheck, keymap, all 16 ACs and every prior-wave fix verified E2E through the real factory), but session_start on an empty branch permanently severs the submission-to-lifecycle wiring so a same-run re-ask + re-confirm wedges completion (FR-4/FR-5); a standing moot question blocks completion forever with no agent-side withdrawal escape hatch; the rule-1-re-ask panel reopen focuses ordered[0] instead of the re-asked question; and the deep-pane pinned region renders goal above description against ui-spec's stated order.
